node.title: Re: can't locate object method new in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Bhabesh347],

This "CSV.pm" that you are showing us appears to be a copy-and-paste of the module's synopsis. That's unnecessary, and if you placed that file into a directory named "Text", that would explain why your MyScript.pl isn't working, since Perl might be loading that instead of the actual module. You may need to install the [mod://Text::CSV] module properly, using either your system's package manager, [doc://cpan], or [mod://cpanm]. This is all just a guess though, as [GrandFather] already said, it'd be best if you give us an [http://www.sscce.org/|SSCCE].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
